name: git diff
purpose: Show line-by-line differences between working directory files, staging area, or commits.
explanation: Displays exact added (`+`) and removed (`-`) lines before you stage or commit.

parameters.description: Show changes already staged with `git add` compared to last commit.

explanationOfOutput: Lines starting with `-` were removed; lines starting with `+` were added.
whenToUse: Before `git commit` to review your exact code edits.
commonMistakes: Running `git diff` after `git add` and seeing nothing because staged changes require `--staged`.
